scenarios.name: walk-start
scenarios.note: Suited. Forward pressed at tick 0 from standing: the first steps and the lean into the walk.

scenarios.name: walk-steady
scenarios.note: Suited. Forward held; the stills start at tick 60, past the start-up, and span one stride a few ticks apart.

scenarios.name: walk-stop
scenarios.note: Suited. Forward released at tick 60 after two seconds of walking: the last steps, the planted feet and the settle to standing.

scenarios.name: run-start
scenarios.note: Suited. Run and forward pressed at tick 0 from standing.

scenarios.name: run-steady
scenarios.note: Suited. Run held; the stills start at tick 60 and span one stride two ticks apart.

scenarios.name: run-stop
scenarios.note: Suited. Run and forward released together at tick 60: the braking steps and the settle to standing.

scenarios.name: turn-in-place
scenarios.note: Suited. Turn pressed with no forward; the world-axes camera shows the body turning against a fixed frame.

scenarios.name: walk-turn
scenarios.note: Suited. Forward and turn together: the gait bends into the curve.

scenarios.name: jump
scenarios.note: Suited. A held jump from standing: crouch and takeoff, the apex and the landing.

scenarios.name: jump-double
scenarios.note: Suited. A second jump pressed in the air spends the last jump and fires the boot jets.

scenarios.name: run-jump
scenarios.note: Suited. A jump pressed at tick 45 in the middle of a run.

scenarios.name: flight-takeoff
scenarios.note: Suited. Flight mode switched on and rise held from standing: the lift-off and the pose changing to flight.

scenarios.name: flight-hover
scenarios.note: Suited. Rise released at tick 60 after a climb: the hover, the exhaust and the idle sway.

scenarios.name: flight-cruise
scenarios.note: Suited. Forward in flight after a climb: the body pitched into the cruise, the legs trailing.

scenarios.name: flight-descent
scenarios.note: Suited. Descend held from a hover: the drop out of the hover pose and the legs reaching for the ground.

scenarios.name: flight-landing
scenarios.note: Suited. The touchdown of a descent and the settle on the ground in flight mode.

scenarios.name: pilot-walk-start
scenarios.note: Pilot (out of the suit). Forward pressed at tick 0 from standing.

scenarios.name: pilot-walk-steady
scenarios.note: Pilot. Forward held; the stills start at tick 60 and span one stride a few ticks apart.

scenarios.name: pilot-walk-stop
scenarios.note: Pilot. Forward released at tick 60 after two seconds of walking.

scenarios.name: pilot-run-start
scenarios.note: Pilot. Run and forward pressed at tick 0 from standing.

scenarios.name: pilot-run-steady
scenarios.note: Pilot. Run held; the stills start at tick 60 and span one stride two ticks apart.

scenarios.name: pilot-run-stop
scenarios.note: Pilot. Run and forward released together at tick 60.

scenarios.name: pilot-turn-in-place
scenarios.note: Pilot. Turn pressed with no forward.

scenarios.name: pilot-jump
scenarios.note: Pilot. The one jump she has: takeoff, apex and landing.
